verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls (docs-x3) let admins define per-destination forwarding rules based on consent/opt-out state, and the 'Transform data as it enters and leaves mParticle' doc (docs-8) implies attribute-level manipulation, but neither piece of evidence explicitly documents hashing or masking of specific PII fields per destination. missing for 10: explicit documentation of field-level hashing, masking transformations, and named PII-filtering rules per destination.
